answer: Gate identity through a yarrow‑seeded commitment ladder: each epoch the beacon emits a prism of challenges whose bands must be answered in strict ledge order; skipping a band or reordering breaks the chain. The first rung costs 10k memory‑hard iterations, each next rung doubles (20k, 40k, 80k…), capping at rung 12 (20.4M iters). A beacon audit verifies each rung against the epoch seed; any skipped rung voids the chain. A swarm of N clones pays N× the full tower cost since each puzzle binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
